finding_key: .github/workflows/agent-iterate-ci.yml::`allowed_bots` may not be a recognized input at the pinned claude-code-action commit; an unknown `with:` key only warns, so the workflow would look fixed while the bot block persists
evidence: The claim is about the input surface of an external action (anthropics/claude-code-action at pinned commit af0559ee, agent-iterate-ci.yml:151/160), and it explicitly concedes it "cannot be confirmed from the tree"; the action's action.yml is listed as not supplied and my working directory is empty, so I could not read it. To my knowledge `allowed_bots` is a declared input of claude-code-action v1 (comma-separated bot logins, with `*` documented as unsafe on public repos) — exactly the semantics the added comment in agent-iterate-ci.yml:155-158 and agent-review-panel.yml:441-446 describes, which suggests the author read the action's actual docs/source rather than inventing the key. So the described defect (unknown `with:` key silently dropped, leaving the bot block in place) is most likely not present, though I cannot rule it out for that exact pinned SHA; if it were true it would be a major silent no-op of the whole fix.
